Field service where the truck is

Truck stopped or unable to get to a workshop? Call Clive with your location and symptoms to discuss mobile heavy diesel support across Victoria.

Call Clive · 0474 372 852

Call with your location first

Give the road, nearest town, suburb or postcode and direction of travel where relevant. A map pin can help explain a remote location. Tell Clive whether the truck is on a roadside, in a yard or at a worksite, and describe any access restrictions.

For an immediate emergency or danger, call 000. This website does not provide emergency dispatch or confirm that a vehicle is safe to drive.

What is the truck doing?

  • Truck make, model and registration.
  • What happened just before the truck stopped or the warning appeared.
  • Warning messages, noises, leaks or loss of drive.
  • Whether a trailer is attached and any site access details.
  • A safe contact number and your current location.

Clive will discuss availability and whether field service suits the problem. Attendance and timing are confirmed directly.

Not every repair can happen on site

The type of fault, safe access, equipment and parts requirements affect where work can be performed. An enquiry may need a workshop assessment or another arrangement. Calling first helps establish a practical next step.

For an urgent issue, call Clive to confirm availability. Text messages may not be seen immediately.

Melbourne and regional Victoria

Use the Victoria suburb and postcode lookup if you need help identifying a location. Travel is arranged around your location and the work required. Call before arranging attendance.
